topic: Standardizing release notes and firmware review
summary_markdown:
A process was agreed upon to implement a single, continuous numbering system for all releases, regardless of the component being updated. Release notes must clearly specify which parts (e.g., firmware, configuration) are affected and which are not.

Separately, discussion occurred regarding the review status of firmware 51.2.1. It was noted that no one had reviewed these data yet, but a plan was made to look at the firmware data on Friday when sufficient data would be available.
decisions: Implement single continuous numbering for all releases.
Release notes must specify affected and unaffected components (e.g., Firmware, Configuration).
Review of firmware 51.2.1 data is scheduled for Friday.
action_items: Ensure release notes follow the new standardized format.
